ps.en: When the first [[casualty]] at the Riverbend plant was reported, the company's response was swift and [[savage]] — lawyers arrived before ambulances. For a decade the firm had traded [[safety]] for margin, and every [[saving]] on protective gear had looked like a [[bargain]]. What the workers got was a [[bare]] minimum: thin helmets, no masks, [[barely]] an hour of training. A single [[caution]] sign hung above a door that no inspector had ever opened.
ps.zh: 河湾工厂的第一名伤亡者上报之后，公司的反应迅速而凶狠——律师比救护车先到。十年来，这家公司一直拿安全换利润，在防护装备上节省的每一笔开支，看上去都像一笔划算的买卖。工人拿到的是最低标准：单薄的安全帽、没有面罩、培训不足一小时。一扇从来没有检查员打开过的门上，挂着一块孤零零的警告牌。

ps.en: Then a young engineer named Lin decided to [[safeguard]] what the paperwork had abandoned. She photographed the rusted [[bar]] welded across the emergency exit and logged every shift that ran without a supervisor. Her colleagues called her [[cautious]] to the point of paralysis. She called them lucky — and luck, she said, is not a safeguard; it is only the delay of a savage reckoning.
ps.zh: 后来，一位名叫林的年轻工程师决定去守护被文件抛弃的东西。她拍下焊死在紧急出口上的锈铁杠，记下每一个没有主管值班的班次。同事说她谨慎得近乎瘫痪。她说他们只是运气好——而运气，她答道，不是守护，只是让凶狠的清算晚一点到来。

ps.en: Her dossier reached the provincial regulator in March. Within a week the agency laid down a [[ban]] on night operations and ordered the exits cleared — a clause that would [[save]] more lives, Lin noted, than any speech ever had. Nobody thanked her. The owner told the local paper that she had inflated a routine caution into a scandal, and that the plant's record, measured over twenty years, was excellent. He was right, of course. It was the twenty-first year that killed people.
ps.zh: 三月，她的材料送到了省监管局。一周之内，监管方下令禁止该厂夜间作业，并要求清空所有出口——林指出，这一条款能救的人命，比任何演讲都多。没有人感谢她。厂主对当地报纸说，她把一次例行的警告夸大成丑闻，而这家工厂二十年来的安全记录堪称优秀。当然，他说得没错。但真正要人命的，是第二十一年。

ps.en: Mira had spent four years on one canvas: a [[panorama]] of the river valley as it had looked before the dam, painted at a [[scale]] no gallery in the city could hang. The [[scenery]] was not really the point. What she was after was a [[scene]] at dusk, when the water held the last of the light and every colour seemed borrowed from somewhere else.
ps.zh: 米拉在一幅画布上花了四年：画的是大坝建成之前的河谷全景，尺幅之大，城里没有哪家画廊挂得下。风景其实不是重点。她要的是黄昏那一刻的景象——水面兜住最后一点光，所有颜色都像是从别处借来的。

ps.en: The commission was judged by a [[panel]] of five, and the [[pace]] of their deliberation was glacial. One member complained that four years of [[elaborate]] preparation had produced something almost [[abstract]] — beautiful, but cold. Another said the [[element]] she had missed was the simplest of all: a painting has to move someone. To [[prove]] them wrong she had only to finish it. To prove them right, she would have to begin again.
ps.zh: 委托由五位评委组成的专门小组裁定，而他们审议的节奏慢得像冰川。一位成员抱怨说，四年的精心准备换来的东西近乎抽象——美，但冷。另一位说，她漏掉的那个要素其实最简单：一幅画得打动人。要证明他们错了，她只需把它画完。要证明他们对了，她得从头再来。

ps.en: She chose the harder road. That winter she [[eliminated|eliminate]] two of the three canvases, cut the horizon loose from its frame, and taught herself again from [[elementary]] principles: where the eye rests, and where it must move. The finished work was smaller, quieter, far more [[elegant]]. The committee hung it in the east wing, where the light is worst and nobody stands for long. Mira went every Sunday, alone, and stood there for an hour.
ps.zh: 她选了更难的那条路。那年冬天，她削掉三块画布中的两块，把地平线从边框里松开，又用最基本的原理把自己重新教了一遍：眼睛落在哪里，又必须移向哪里。成品更小、更静，也优雅得多。委员会把它挂进东翼——那里光线最差，也没人久留。米拉每周日都去，一个人站上一个钟头。

ps.en: Zhou had built her [[career]] on other people's quarrels. She was called in to [[mediate]] when a shipping firm and a coastal town could not agree on who owned the water — a [[case]] two courts had already failed to settle — and called again when two universities fought over the same archive. Her rule was [[absolute]]: no agreement counted unless both sides left the room slightly unhappy. [[Provided|provided]] nobody left humiliated, she would sign.
ps.zh: 周的职业建立在别人的争执之上。一家航运公司和一座海滨小镇为水域归属争不出结果时，她被请去调停——这桩案子已经打输过两级法院；后来两所大学争夺同一批档案，她又被请去。她的规矩是绝对的：协议若不能让双方都略带不甘地走出房间，就不算成立。只要没有人被羞辱，她就签字。

ps.en: The work took more out of her than she ever admitted. Before each session she sat for twenty minutes of [[meditation]] — not for calm, she said, but to keep herself from [[absorbing|absorb]] the anger in the room. Her [[absence]] from the shouting was the only leverage she had. Colleagues who watched her took her for [[absent]] in the ordinary sense — dreamy, slow to answer. She let them.
ps.zh: 这份工作消耗她的，远比她承认的多。每次开场前，她会静坐冥想二十分钟——她说不是为了平静，而是为了不把房间里的怒气吸进自己身上。从争吵中抽身缺席，是她唯一的筹码。看着她的同事以为她就是平常意义上的缺席——神游、反应慢。她随他们这么想。

ps.en: Two years ago the [[media]] found her, and the spectacle of a mediator who would not speak in public became, for a season, a story. Television wanted a [[medium]]; she gave it four written lines and no face. Invitations began arriving from [[abroad]]. She declined them all and went back to the table. What that table could [[provide]], she said, was the one thing no broadcast ever had — time.
ps.zh: 两年前，媒体发现了她，“一个拒绝公开讲话的调停者”这出奇观因此红极一时。电视台想要一个媒介，她只给了四行书面声明，连脸都不给。国外的邀约也开始来。她全部回绝，回到桌前。她说，那张桌子能提供的，是任何电视节目都不曾有过的东西——时间。

ps.en: The [[capital]] was four hundred miles away, and the law it passed was elegant on paper: the trade in wild parrots was [[abolished|abolish]], effective at once. On the ground, in the estuary, it was Shen who had to make the words mean something. She was [[capable]] of the fieldwork and, more usefully, of the waiting; her [[capacity]] for sitting still in a hide from dark to dark was, colleagues said, almost unnatural.
ps.zh: 首都在四百英里之外，它通过的那部法律在纸面上很漂亮：野生鹦鹉的买卖即日起彻底废除。但在河口这片地面上，得由沈来让这些法律条文真正落地生效。她胜任野外作业，更有用的是她耐得住等；同事们说，她在掩体里从日落到日落纹丝不动的本事，几乎不像常人。

ps.en: The raid began with a [[casual]] remark — a boatman mentioning, offhand, that someone upstream had been buying cages by the dozen. Shen spent six weeks on it. [[Careful|careful]] work, not brave work: counting landings, matching hulls, logging fuel. On the last night she [[cast]] a net across the channel mouth and [[caught|catch]] three men, forty birds, and a ledger. The birds went to a rehabilitation centre; the men, to a [[category]] of charge that had not existed in the province three years earlier.
ps.zh: 这次抓捕始于一句随意的话——一个船夫随口提到，上游有人成打成打地买笼子。沈为此花了六周。这是细致的活，不是勇敢的活：数靠岸次数、比对船体、记录加油。最后一夜，她在水道口撒下网，抓到三个人、四十只鸟和一本账。鸟送去救助站；人被按一项三年前本省尚不存在的罪名提起指控。

ps.en: The parrots themselves were another matter. Most had been [[captive]] since they were chicks; released, they would not survive. Their [[capture]] had been, for the village, a livelihood, and Shen understood that a ban which [[catered|cater]] to nobody's needs would simply drive the trade underground. So she argued — in the [[cause]] of the birds, which was also the cause of the village — for a fund that paid former trappers to guard nests instead.
ps.zh: 鹦鹉本身是另一桩麻烦。它们大多从雏鸟起就被囚养，放归也活不下来。而对村子来说，捕获它们曾是生计；沈明白，一部不迁就任何人需求的禁令，只会把交易逼到地下。于是她为鸟——也是为村子——争取到一笔基金，雇曾经的捕鸟人转而守巢。

words.exam: 维护；保护；捍卫；防护措施
c: safeguard national interests 维护国家利益
a safeguard against fraud 防欺诈的保障措施
safeguard the rights of consumers 保障消费者权利
fam: safe adj. 安全的 → safety n. 安全 → safeguard v./n.
words.dif: safeguard 强调「防患于未然」的制度性保护；protect 泛指任何保护；defend 侧重抵御外来攻击
words.pat: Clear rules safeguard the public interest far better than good intentions do.
words.patZh: 明确的规则远比善意更能守护公众利益。

c: road safety 道路安全
for safety's sake 为了安全起见
a safety net 安全网；保障措施
in safety 安全地
fam: safe adj. → safety n. → safely adv.
words.dif: safety 指「免于危险的状态」；security 指「免于攻击与威胁的保障」，多用于国家与财产语境
words.pat: Safety is not a cost to be trimmed; it is the floor everything else stands on.
words.patZh: 安全不是可以削减的成本，而是其他一切赖以立足的地板。

words.exam: 野蛮的；残暴的；未开化的人；野蛮人；猛烈抨击
c: a savage attack 猛烈的攻击
savage criticism 尖刻的批评
a savage beast 猛兽
be savaged by the press 被媒体痛批
words.dif: savage 强调「未开化的凶蛮」，可指人也可指言论；brutal 强调「冷酷无情」；fierce 只是「猛烈」
words.pat: The proposal was savaged by critics who had not read past its first page.
words.patZh: 这份提案被那些连第一页都没读完的批评者痛批了一顿。

words.exam: 救；拯救；储蓄；节省；除…之外
c: save sb from sth 把某人从…中救出
save up for 为…攒钱
save time / money 省时、省钱
save for 除…以外
words.dif: save 作介词表「除…之外」是僻义，多与 all 连用（all save one）；rescue 只指把人从危险中营救出来
words.pat: No single measure will save the industry, but a dozen small ones might.
words.patZh: 没有哪一项单独的举措能挽救这个行业，但十几项小举措也许可以。

c: a saving of 20% 节省两成
cost savings 成本节约
life savings 一生的积蓄
energy savings 节能
fam: save v. → saving n.（指省下的量）→ savings n.（恒用复数，指存款）
words.dif: saving 指「省下的量」；savings 恒用复数，指「存款」。两者混用是写作高频错误
words.pat: The savings from the new system paid for themselves within a year.
words.patZh: 新系统省下的钱，一年之内就回了本。

words.exam: 刻度；天平；磅秤；规模；程度；范围
c: on a large / massive scale 大规模地
at the scale of 以…的规模
a scale of 1 to 100 一到一百的刻度
economies of scale 规模经济
words.dif: scale 指「规模与量级」；size 只指物理大小；extent 强调「延伸所及的程度」
words.pat: Problems that look trivial at the individual scale can be overwhelming at the national one.
words.patZh: 在个人层面微不足道的问题，放到国家层面可能难以承受。

words.exam: 景色；舞台；现场；地点；争吵；吵闹
c: on the scene 在现场
behind the scenes 在幕后
a crime scene 犯罪现场
make a scene 当众吵闹
fam: scenery n. 风景；舞台布景
words.dif: scene 侧重「一幕、一个特定场面」，可指现场或争吵；scenery 是不可数的「自然风景」总称
words.pat: Behind the scenes, the decision had been made long before the vote.
words.patZh: 在幕后，这个决定早在投票之前就已经作出了。

c: mountain scenery 山间景色
enjoy the scenery 欣赏风景
stage scenery 舞台布景
fam: scene n. → scenery n. → scenic adj. 风景优美的
words.dif: scenery 不可数，泛指一地的自然风光；scene 可数，指某一处具体景致或场面
words.pat: The scenery alone would justify the journey, even if the town had nothing else to offer.
words.patZh: 哪怕镇上再无别的看头，单凭这风景也值这一趟。

c: at a steady pace 以平稳的速度
keep pace with 跟上…的步伐
set the pace 领跑，定调
the pace of life 生活节奏
words.dif: pace 强调「持续推进的节奏」；speed 只指快慢；tempo 多用于音乐与活动的节奏
words.pat: Technology changes at a pace that institutions cannot keep up with.
words.patZh: 技术变化的速度，是制度跟不上的。

c: a panel of judges 评委小组
a panel discussion 小组讨论
solar panel 太阳能板
be on the panel 担任小组成员
words.dif: panel 是「为特定任务临时组成的小组」；committee 是长期设立的委员会；board 是决策层
words.pat: The panel spent three days on a decision the public had expected within hours.
words.patZh: 公众以为几小时就能出的结论，评审小组花了三天。

c: a panorama of the city 城市全景
the political panorama 政治全貌
take in the panorama 一览全景
words.dif: panorama 强调「一览无余的全貌」，可指视野也可指全局概观；view 只是「看到的一片景象」
words.pat: From the ridge the whole valley opened out like a panorama no photograph could hold.
words.patZh: 从山脊上望去，整个河谷铺展开来，像一幅照片装不下的全景画。

c: prove to be 证明是
prove sb wrong 证明某人错了
prove one's point 证实自己的观点
prove useful 证明有用
words.dif: prove 后接形容词或 to be 时表「结果是」，不是「证明」；demonstrate 侧重「当众演示」
words.pat: It is one thing to prove a theory; it is another to persuade anyone to act on it.
words.patZh: 证明一个理论是一回事，说服人照它行动是另一回事。

c: provide sb with sth 向某人提供某物
provide for 供养；为…作准备
provide that... 规定…
provide against 防备
words.dif: provide sb with sth 与 provide sth for sb 语序相反；supply 与 provide 近义，但 supply 更强调大批量配给
words.pat: The most valuable thing a mentor can provide is not answers but better questions.
words.patZh: 一位导师能提供的最有价值的东西不是答案，而是更好的问题。

c: provided that... 倘若…
provided (that) sb does sth 只要某人做…
only provided 只有在…条件下
fam: provide v. 提供 → provided conj. 倘若（同形，词性不同）
words.dif: provided 引导真实条件，不用于虚拟语气（不能说 provided sb would do）；if 可兼表真实与虚拟条件
words.pat: Provided the terms are clear, most people will accept a settlement they dislike.
words.patZh: 只要条款清楚，多数人会接受一个自己并不喜欢的和解方案。

c: mediate between A and B 在 A 与 B 之间调停
mediate a dispute 调解争端
mediate in a conflict 在冲突中斡旋
words.dif: mediate 是居间促成和解，第三方没有裁决权；arbitrate 是仲裁，第三方有裁决权
words.pat: To mediate well you must be trusted by two parties who do not trust each other.
words.patZh: 要调停得好，你必须被两个互不信任的当事方同时信任。

c: in meditation 在冥想中
daily meditation 每日冥想
a meditation on sth 对…的沉思
words.dif: meditation 指「静坐冥想」或「沉思之作」；reflection 强调「回顾与思考」，不需要静坐
words.pat: Ten minutes of meditation is not an escape from the problem but a way of seeing it whole.
words.patZh: 十分钟的冥想不是逃避问题，而是看清它的全貌。

words.exam: 媒介（物）；媒体；方法；中等的
c: a medium of communication 交流媒介
the medium of instruction 教学语言
of medium height 中等身材
a happy medium 折中之道
fam: media n. 媒体（原为 medium 的复数）
words.dif: medium 单数指「一种媒介或手段」，复数 media 指「媒体」整体；作形容词表「中等的」
words.pat: The medium shapes the message more than most people who use it care to admit.
words.patZh: 媒介对信息的塑造，比多数使用者愿意承认的要深。

c: the mass media 大众传媒
media coverage 媒体报道
social media 社交媒体
draw media attention 引来媒体关注
fam: medium n. 媒介 → media n. 媒体（原为 medium 的复数，今多作集合名词）
words.dif: media 现多作集合名词，谓语可单可复；指「多媒体」时是另一种搭配（multimedia）
words.pat: What the media choose not to report shapes opinion as powerfully as what they print.
words.patZh: 媒体选择不报道什么，与它们登出什么，同样有力地塑造着舆论。

words.exam: 精心计划（或制作）的；详尽的；复杂的；精心制作；详述
c: an elaborate design 精巧的设计
elaborate on / upon 对…详加说明
an elaborate excuse 编得天花乱坠的借口
words.dif: elaborate 作形容词重音在第二音节（-rət），作动词重音不变但尾音读 -reɪt；考试常考 elaborate on 表「详述」
words.pat: He refused to elaborate on a decision that had taken a year to reach.
words.patZh: 一个花了一年才作出的决定，他拒绝多加解释。

c: an elegant solution 简洁的方案
an elegant woman 优雅的女士
an elegant proof 漂亮的证明
words.dif: elegant 在学术语境常指「简洁而精妙」（an elegant solution），不等于「花哨」；graceful 侧重动作的优美
words.pat: The best explanations are usually the shortest, and the most elegant proof is the one nobody has to reread.
words.patZh: 最好的解释通常最短，而最优雅的证明，是不必有人读第二遍的那个。

c: an essential element 必不可少的要素
an element of surprise 几分意外的成分
the elements 基础原理；恶劣天气
be in one's element 如鱼得水
fam: elemental adj. 基本的，自然的
words.dif: element 指「构成整体的成分」；factor 指「影响结果的因素」——前者是被组成的，后者是起作用的
words.pat: What was missing was not skill but an element that cannot be taught: patience.
words.patZh: 缺的不是技巧，而是一个教不来的要素：耐心。

c: elementary school 小学
elementary principles 基本原理
an elementary mistake 低级错误
fam: element n. 元素，要素 → elementary adj. → elementarily adv.
words.dif: elementary 表「基础的」时是中性甚至褒义（elementary principles），但它也常表「幼稚的、低级的」（an elementary mistake），要看语境
words.pat: Most failures are elementary; they are simply expensive.
words.patZh: 大多数失败都是低级错误，只是代价高昂。

c: eliminate the possibility of 排除…的可能
be eliminated from 从…中被淘汰
eliminate waste 消除浪费
eliminate sb from consideration 将某人排除在考虑之外
words.dif: eliminate 是「彻底除去」（可指人、物或可能性）；exclude 是「不纳入范围」，被排除者不一定消失
words.pat: The quickest way to eliminate an error is to find out why it seemed reasonable.
words.patZh: 消除一个错误最快的方法，是弄清它当初为什么显得合理。

c: in the abstract 抽象地，理论上
abstract concept 抽象概念
an abstract of a paper 论文摘要
abstract sth from 从…中提取
words.dif: 作形容词重音在前（ˈæbstrækt），作动词重音在后（æbˈstrækt）；abstract 与 concrete（具体的）成对出现
words.pat: It is easy to defend a principle in the abstract and hard to apply it to the person in front of you.
words.patZh: 在抽象层面捍卫一项原则很容易，把它用在眼前这个具体的人身上却很难。

c: abolish slavery 废除奴隶制
abolish the death penalty 废除死刑
abolish a tax 取消一项税
call for the abolition of 呼吁废除…
words.dif: abolish 用于制度、法律、习俗等抽象事物；cancel 只用于具体安排（取消会议、订单）
words.pat: You can abolish a law in an afternoon; you cannot abolish the habit it fed.
words.patZh: 一条法律一个下午就能废除，它养出的习惯却废不掉。

c: in the absence of 在缺乏…的情况下
absence from school 缺课
a conspicuous absence 显眼的缺席
absence of mind 心不在焉
words.dif: absence 既可指「人不在」也可指「某物不存在」；lack 只指「缺乏」，不指人的缺席
words.pat: In the absence of evidence, speculation fills the space within a day.
words.patZh: 缺少证据时，猜测一天之内就会填满那片空白。

c: be absent from 缺席…
absent without leave 擅离职守
an absent look 心不在焉的神情
words.dif: be absent from 后接地点或场合；absent 作定语时表「心不在焉的」——与「缺席」是两个考点
words.pat: She answered correctly, but with the absent air of someone listening to something else.
words.patZh: 她答对了，却带着一种心不在焉的神情，像是还在听别的声音。

words.exam: 到国外；在国外；广为流传
c: go abroad 出国
study abroad 留学
at home and abroad 在国内外
be spread abroad 广为流传
fam: abroad 本身就是副词，没有 abroadly 之类的派生形式 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: abroad 是副词，不能说 go to abroad / in abroad；overseas 还可作形容词（overseas students）
words.pat: Ideas travel abroad faster than the laws that govern them.
words.patZh: 观念的传播，比管辖它的法律走得更快。

words.exam: 完全的；绝对的；不受任何限制（或约束）的；肯定的；确实的
c: absolute majority 绝对多数
absolute power 绝对权力
in absolute terms 按绝对值计算
absolute certainty 完全的确定
words.dif: absolute 强调「无条件、无例外」；complete 强调「组成部分齐全」。两者常同时出现在选项里
words.pat: Absolute power is not only corrupting; it is also, eventually, incompetent.
words.patZh: 绝对权力不仅使人腐化，最终还会让人无能。

c: be absorbed in 全神贯注于…
absorb the shock 承受冲击
absorb information 吸收信息
absorb costs 自行消化成本
words.dif: be absorbed in 表「全神贯注」，是高频考点；absorb 表「承受冲击、消化成本」常见于经济类阅读
words.pat: An economy that cannot absorb a shock will pass it on to the people least able to carry it.
words.patZh: 一个消化不了冲击的经济体，会把冲击转嫁给最无力承担的人。

c: ban sb from doing sth 禁止某人做…
impose a ban on 对…实施禁令
lift a ban 解除禁令
a smoking ban 禁烟令
words.dif: ban 多指官方明令禁止，语气最硬；forbid 可以是个人或权威的禁止；prohibit 多用于法律条文
words.pat: A ban that nobody can enforce teaches people to ignore the law.
words.patZh: 一条无人能执行的禁令，只会教人学会无视法律。

c: bar sb from doing sth 禁止某人做…
bar the door 闩上门
behind bars 在狱中
a bar of chocolate 一条巧克力
fam: barred adj. 有横条的；被禁止的
words.dif: bar 表「禁止」时常用于被动 be barred from；表「酒吧」时是可数名词。同形多义，靠搭配区分
words.pat: Access to the archive was barred to anyone without written permission.
words.patZh: 没有书面许可，任何人都进不了那间档案室。

c: a bare minimum 最低限度
bare feet 光脚
the bare facts 不加渲染的事实
with bare hands 徒手
words.dif: bare 作定语表「仅仅的、最低的」（a bare minimum），与「赤裸的」是同一词的两个考点；barely 是副词「几乎不」，与 hardly 近义
words.pat: The proposal survived by a bare margin of two votes.
words.patZh: 这份提案以两票的微弱优势过关。

c: barely enough 勉强够
barely visible 几乎看不见
can barely do 几乎做不到
barely had... when... 刚…就…
fam: bare adj. 赤裸的；仅仅的 → barely adv.
words.dif: barely 本身含否定，不能再与 not 连用；barely... when... 表「刚…就…」，是倒装句的经典考点
words.pat: Barely had the report been published when the industry began rewriting its rules.
words.patZh: 报告刚发表，整个行业就开始改写规则了。

c: a good bargain 便宜货
strike a bargain 达成协议
bargain with sb over sth 与某人就…讨价还价
into the bargain 另外，而且
fam: bargainer n. 讨价还价的人
words.dif: bargain 作名词兼「便宜货」与「协议」两义；作动词表「议价」，后接介词 for / over / about
words.pat: What looks like a bargain at the signing usually is not one at the ending.
words.patZh: 签合同时看起来划算的买卖，到收尾时通常就不划算了。

c: be capable of doing sth 有能力做…
a capable administrator 能干的管理者
capable hands 可靠的人手
words.dif: capable 后必须接 of doing；able 后接 to do。这一条几乎是必考的差别
words.pat: Anyone capable of finishing this work is also capable of finding reasons not to.
words.patZh: 能做完这件工作的人，也一定有能力找出一堆不做的理由。

c: at full capacity 满负荷运转
capacity for doing sth 做…的能力
seating capacity 座位数
build capacity 建设能力
words.dif: capacity 指「容纳量」或「潜在的承受能力」，常与 at full capacity 搭配；capability 指「已具备的做事本领」
words.pat: Systems rarely fail at the moment of crisis; they fail because they were run at full capacity for years.
words.patZh: 系统很少是在危机那一刻坏掉的，它们坏掉，是因为多年来一直满负荷运转。

c: raise capital 筹集资本
human capital 人力资本
capital investment 资本投入
the capital city 首都
words.dif: capital 表「资本」时不可数，表「首都」时可数；与 capitol（美国国会大厦）只差一个字母
words.pat: Attention is the scarce capital of the modern economy.
words.patZh: 注意力才是现代经济中稀缺的资本。

c: hold sb captive 囚禁某人
a captive audience 无法离场的听众
take sb captive 俘获某人
captive animals 圈养动物
words.dif: captive 强调「被关着的状态」；capture 是动词「捕获」；captivity 是名词「囚禁」。三者同源易混
words.pat: A captive audience is not a persuaded one.
words.patZh: 被迫在座的听众，并不等于被说服的听众。

words.exam: 捕获；攻占；准确的表达；描绘
c: capture sb's attention 抓住某人的注意力
capture the mood 准确传达那种情绪
capture a market 占领市场
avoid capture 免于被捕
words.dif: capture 的僻义是「准确表达、描绘」（capture the spirit of the age），阅读中常作此义，极易漏
words.pat: Statistics can describe a trend but rarely capture what it feels like to live through it.
words.patZh: 数据能描述一种趋势，却很少能传达亲历其中是什么滋味。

c: a career in 在…方面的职业
career prospects 职业前景
career path 职业路径
a career woman 职业女性
words.dif: career 指「长期从事的职业与生涯」；job 指「一份具体工作」；profession 指「需要专业训练的职业」
words.pat: A career is built out of what you are willing to do on the days nobody is watching.
words.patZh: 职业是由那些没人看着的日子里，你愿意做的事搭起来的。

c: be careful with 对…小心
be careful to do sth 注意要做…
careful consideration 审慎的考虑
a careful reader 细心的读者
fam: care n./v. → careful adj. → carefully adv. → carelessness n. 粗心
words.dif: be careful to do 表「特意去做到」；be careful of 表「提防」。两者含义相反，是高频陷阱
words.pat: Careful reading is a slower habit than most people are willing to pay for.
words.patZh: 细致阅读这种习惯，比多数人愿意付出的代价要慢。

c: in any case 无论如何
in case of 万一发生…
a case in point 恰当的例子
make a case for 为…提出理由
words.dif: in case 后接从句（以防…），in case of 后接名词（万一…），in any case 表「无论如何」。三者常混
words.pat: Every policy looks reasonable until it meets a case that was not imagined when it was written.
words.patZh: 每一项政策看起来都合理，直到它遇上一个起草时没人设想过的案例。

c: cast a net 撒网
cast a shadow on 给…蒙上阴影
cast doubt on 使…受到质疑
cast a vote 投票
the cast 全体演员
fam: casting n. 铸造；角色分配
broadcast v. 广播（原义「广泛撒播」）
words.dif: cast 是原形、过去式、过去分词同形的不规则动词；cast doubt on 是阅读高频搭配，不是「投掷疑问」
words.pat: One careless sentence can cast doubt on years of careful work.
words.patZh: 一句不慎的话，就能让多年的细致工作受到质疑。

words.exam: 偶然的；随便的；非正式的
c: a casual remark 随口一说
casual clothes 便装
casual labour 临时工
a casual acquaintance 泛泛之交
words.dif: casual 表「偶然、随口」时不带贬义；careless 表「粗心」，带贬义。考试常拿两者对照设题
words.pat: A casual remark, repeated often enough, becomes a policy nobody voted for.
words.patZh: 一句随口的话，重复得够多，就成了一条谁也没投过票的政策。

c: heavy casualties 重大伤亡
the first casualty of 第一个牺牲品
civilian casualties 平民伤亡
be a casualty of 成为…的牺牲品
fam: casual adj. 随意的 → casualty n.（同源，但含义已完全分离）
words.dif: casualty 是「伤亡者」，不是「意外」；与 casual 词形相近而含义无关，是最容易被误读的一对
words.pat: The first casualty of a long argument is usually the truth.
words.patZh: 一场漫长争论的第一个牺牲品，通常是真相。

c: catch sb doing sth 撞见某人正在做…
catch a cold 感冒
catch up with 赶上
catch sb's attention 引起某人注意
fam: 不规则变化：catch - caught - caught n. 相关延伸
words.dif: catch sb doing 表「撞见」，不是「抓住」；catch up with 表「赶上进度」，不一定是物理追上
words.pat: We rarely catch ourselves in the moment of being unkind.
words.patZh: 我们很少能当场抓住自己不善良的那一刻。

c: fall into a category 属于某一类别
a broad category 大类
be in a category of its own 独树一帜
fam: categorical adj. 断然的，绝对的
words.dif: category 是「分类的项」；categorical 的常见义是「断然的、绝对的」（a categorical denial），不是「分类的」
words.pat: A new kind of problem rarely arrives with a category already waiting for it.
words.patZh: 新类型的问题出现时，很少已经有现成的类别在等着它。

words.exam: 提供饮食；满足需要；迎合
c: cater for 满足…的需要；为…供餐
cater to 迎合（趣味、口味）
cater for a wedding 承办婚宴
words.dif: cater for 是「供给、照料需要」，中性；cater to 常含贬义，指「迎合不好的趣味」
words.pat: A public service that caters only to the loudest voices ends up serving no one.
words.patZh: 只迎合声音最大者的公共服务，最终谁都服务不了。

words.exam: 导致；引起；原因；事业；目标
c: cause damage 造成损害
the cause of …的原因
cause and effect 因果
fight for a cause 为一项事业奋斗
words.dif: cause 表「事业、目标」是高频僻义（a worthy cause），别只记「导致」；reason 是「理由」，与 cause（起因）不同
words.pat: It is easier to name a cause than to prove one.
words.patZh: 说出一个原因，比证明一个原因要容易得多。

c: with caution 小心地
throw caution to the wind 不顾一切
a caution against 对…的警告
caution sb against doing 警告某人不要做…
words.dif: caution 作名词兼「谨慎」与「警告」两义；cautious 是形容词。词性混用是常见错误
words.pat: The report was read with caution by exactly the people it was written about.
words.patZh: 这份报告，被最该读它的人小心翼翼地读了。

c: be cautious about 对…持保留态度
a cautious welcome 有保留的欢迎
cautious optimism 谨慎的乐观
a cautious driver 谨慎的司机
fam: caution n./vt. → cautious adj. → cautiously adv.
words.dif: be cautious of 强调「提防某人」；be cautious about 强调「对某事持保留态度」。介词不同，含义不同
words.pat: Cautious optimism is what you feel when the evidence is good but the history is not.
words.patZh: 当证据很好而历史不佳时，人感到的就是谨慎的乐观。
